QUOTE: "in the default configuration, mbedtls runs no threads of its own and takes no locks." and "In the sample programs (all gated by `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C`/`PTHREAD`, so not built by default)"
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says the library spawns no threads by default, but it lists thread sites in `programs/` and never says the default build has zero threads or that the pthread example compiles to a stub main.
